translation: The Suwen, Treatise on Contralateral Needling (繆刺論), says: When a person has fallen from a height, evil blood (惡血) remains within, the abdomen is full and distended, and one cannot pass urine or stool; first drink a purgative medicine. This is injury above to the Jueyin (厥陰) vessel, and injury below to the Shaoyin (少陰) collateral. Needle below the medial malleolus of the foot, before Rangu (然谷), where there is a blood vessel, and let blood; needle the moving vessel on the dorsum of the foot. If it does not stop, needle the three hairs (三毛) with one needling each; when blood appears, it stops at once.
